description: Conformance vectors for the JWT form of a mandate (spec section 6.10). `links`: each `jwt` decodes to `body`, its header and claims are `header` and `claims`, and its signature verifies under the key of `signer`. `tokens`: judge each at the instant `nowMs`. A spending token is verified as a chain, with keys derived from the did:aroha:z identifiers; a task token is verified as one link under the key of `signer`. `expect.valid` is the verdict; for a valid spending token `rootGrantor`, the leaf `mandateId` and the number of `links` must match too. Keys are the RFC 8032 section 7.1 test keys.
